notes.title: Dark Invasion VR - Fresh update!
notes.content:
What's new?

Infected zombies now have tentacles, claws and etc.

Updated the effect of teleporting zombies and aliens.

The order of passing the levels has appeared.

notes.title: Update turn options!
notes.content:
*Now in the game options, you can choose the type of turn!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36211720/dfb244c81e7c1fdae2c0f1e23344ea3002907bb0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Some changes with the Update!
notes.content:
*Update in control movement - Now to activate running and turns, make a touch and slide of the touchpad!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36211720/cfb9580619803492202c711cf78f875e470b91ab.jpg[/img]
